Method.name: getCommentForFile
Method.Implementation: set tSC = $$$OK set tempFile = extNm _ "TEMP" set cmd = $$$SVNINFO _ " --username " _ userNm _ " --password " _ passwd _ " " _ extNm _ " > " _ tempFile Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNINFO _ " for: " _ extNm _ " cmd stat: " _ stat) if (stat = 0) { Do ..tComments.WriteLine("ItemName: "_ itemNm) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).findStringInFile(tempFile, "Last", ..tComments ) Do ##class(%Library.File).Delete(tempFile) } else { Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("ERROR: Unable to run svn info command for: " _ extNm) set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$EnsErrGeneral, "Unable to run command " _ $$$SVNINFO _ " for: " _ extNm) } Return tSC

Method.name: CheckinFiles
Method.Implementation:
Set tSC = $$$OK Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( "Checkin: " _ files _ " as " _ userNm _ ", Comment: " _ comment) For I=1:1:$L(files," ") { set fullPath = $ZSTRIP($P(files," ",I),"<>W") if fullPath = "" { continue } Set cmd = $$$SVNINFO _ " --username " _ userNm _ " --password " _ passwd _ " " _ fullPath Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile(fullPath _ " svn info:" _ stat)
If stat '= 0 { // files not in svn, add the file Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNINFO _" returned no information" ) Set cmd = $$$SVNADD _ " --username " _ userNm _ " --password " _ passwd _ " " _ fullPath Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("svn add:" _ stat) If stat '= 0 { Set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$EnsErrGeneral, "SVN add error for " _ fullPath) Return tSC } } } set tempFile = ##class(%Library.File).TempFilename() Set cmd = $$$SVNCOMMIT _ " --no-auth-cache --non-interactive --username " _ userNm _ " --password " _ passwd _ " -m """ _ comment _ """ " _ files _ " > " _ tempFile Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd)
Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("CheckinFiles: commit stat: " _ stat _ " file: " _ tempFile)
if stat '= 0 { Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("SVN commit error: " _ $$$SVNCOMMIT _ " " _ files) Set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$EnsErrGeneral, "SVN commit error") } else { set tComment = ##class(%Stream.TmpCharacter).%New() Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).findStringInFile(tempFile, "Committed", tComment) // Do ##class(%Library.File).Delete(tempFile) Do tComment.Rewind() set len = 32656 #dim sc as %Status set commitComment = tComment.Read(.len, .sc) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("SVN commit: " _ commitComment) } return tSC
